records.question: How long does Spotify hold on to my personal information?
records.text:
Spotify keeps personal data only as long as it is necessary to provide the Spotify Service and for Spotify's legitimate and essential business purposes, such as maintaining service performance, making data-driven business decisions, complying with legal obligations, and resolving disputes [Spotify – 6. Data retention].

Specific retention periods include:
*   Data input as part of search queries is deleted after 90 days, subject to other applicable retention rules [Spotify – 6. Data retention].
*   Some data, like your Spotify username and profile information, is kept until your Spotify account is deleted [Spotify – 6. Data retention].
*   Streaming history is kept for the life of an account to support personalized recommendations and retrospective playlists [Spotify – 6. Data retention].

Users can also delete certain personal data directly from the Spotify Service, such as editing or deleting their profile picture [Spotify – 6. Data retention]. You have the right to request that Spotify delete certain personal data [Spotify – 6. Data retention].

records.text: Generally, Spotify does not provide refunds or credits for partial subscription periods, unless it is specifically stated in the Terms [Spotify – Billing and cancellation].

records.question: How long does Netflix hang on to my details?
records.text: Netflix retains personal information for as long as is necessary to fulfill specific purposes, which include providing their service, operating their business, researching and improving services, sending marketing and informational messages, supporting advertisements, ensuring safety, security, and fraud prevention, and complying with the law and enforcing the Netflix Terms of Use [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information]. records.question: Can other people read my Zoom Email messages?
records.text:
Zoom Email is end-to-end encrypted by default for emails sent and received directly between active Zoom Email users [Zoom – What Personal Data Do We Receive?]. When an email is end-to-end encrypted, only the users, and potentially account owners or designated account administrators depending on their settings, control the encryption key and thus have access to the email content, including the body text, subject line, attachments, and custom labels [Zoom – What Personal Data Do We Receive?].

However, if you share encrypted content, such as forwarding an encrypted Zoom Email to a third-party recipient without a Zoom Email account, the shared or forwarded content will not be end-to-end encrypted by Zoom [Zoom – Who Can See, Share, and Process My Personal Data When I Join Meetings and Use Other Zoom Products and Services?].

Zoom also has access to email metadata used for basic email delivery, which includes the email addresses in the from, to, cc, and bcc fields, the time, mimeID, and the number and size of attachments [Zoom – What Personal Data Do We Receive?].
cited_labels: [Zoom – What Personal Data Do We Receive?]

records.question: Is Zoom allowed to shut down a service I'm paying for?
records.text: Zoom may terminate or suspend your access to the Services if you fail to comply with any provision of the Agreement or any referenced policies, guides, notices, or statements [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION]. Additionally, Zoom can terminate the Agreement for any reason or no reason after providing thirty (30) business days' advance notice [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION]. If a failure to pay Charges continues for five calendar days after the due date, Zoom may immediately terminate, suspend, or disconnect your Services without prior notice [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES].

records.question: Can a teenager sign up for their own PayPal account?
records.text: To open an account, you must either be an individual who is at least 18 years old or a business that can form a legally binding contract [Paypal – Opening an account].

records.question: How long does PayPal keep my information once I stop being a customer?
records.text:
Personal Information used for the ongoing relationship with PayPal is kept for the duration of that relationship plus 10 years, or for as long as required by applicable local law after the relationship ends, unless a longer retention period is permitted by law for reasons such as legal obligations, bankruptcy laws, AML obligations, litigation, investigations, audit, or compliance practices [Paypal – How Long We Store Your Personal Information].

If you close your PayPal account(s) or profile, PayPal may still need to keep some Personal Information as permitted by applicable law to:
* Complete a transaction, provide requested goods or services, or comply with promises in the user agreement or contract [Paypal – Your rights].
* Detect and prevent fraudulent, malicious, or illegal activity [Paypal – Your rights].
* Protect legal rights [Paypal – Your rights].
* Manage internal business processes related to your expectations when using the Services [Paypal – Your rights].
* Comply with laws and other governmental requirements [Paypal – Your rights].

Additionally, after closing your account, PayPal may retain your electronic money for a time necessary to protect itself and/or any third party against risks like reversals, fees, fines, penalties, and other liabilities [Paypal – Closing Your PayPal Account].
cited_labels: [Paypal – How Long We Store Your Personal Information]

records.question: If I close my Strava account, does my data actually go away?
records.text: After you request account deletion, your personal information is permanently and irreversibly deleted from Strava's systems, including backups [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data]. However, it may take up to 45 days for your personal information and system logs to be deleted from their systems [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data] [Strava – Retention of Information]. Additionally, Strava may keep some information to comply with the law or take other actions permitted by law [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data] [Strava – Retention of Information]. Once your account is deleted, your data, including your activities and place on leaderboards, cannot be reinstated [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data].
cited_labels: [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data]
